heard: A mystery object from deep space was falling toward Earth. This body was only about three feet wide. It traveled in a wide orbit stretching past the moon. But density tests showed it wasn't solid rock. It was a hollow, discarded tank from a lunar mission. The junk hit the atmosphere at nearly 25,000 miles per hour. Clouds blocked the view of the fireball over the ocean, so researchers chartered a business jet to watch it burn. They practiced for real asteroids with this mystery object falling toward Earth.
